adaptations: The baseline-only Bun compatibility rejection becomes a positive native-runtime assertion because Workdeck's Rust watcher does not inherit Bun's filesystem watcher deadlock.

Disk-backed file-pair and Git inputs are reopened through the same dynamic loader used by live session and keyboard reload transactions, then the mounted Ratatui test verifies command request, changeset commit, frame replacement, and old syntax-cache eviction.

Attention marks are tested in Ratatui cells, preserved only across exact content identity, re-keyed when a newly inserted file shifts the invocation-local runtime id, and removed through the real session clear operation.
